desc: Establish reverse reconstruction insight: process i from N down to 1, place i in the P_i-th still-empty slot.
Implement full solution: Fenwick tree over N empty slots + reverse reconstruction (i=N..1, binary-lifting k-th empty query, place i, decrement), read stdin, write stdout.
Verify correctness on both provided samples and edge cases (N=1, all P_i=1, all P_i=i) using a brute-force checker on small random inputs — both samples PASS.
